read.thesis: Consumer card franchise is strong: billed business +8% to $454B, net card fees +17%, provision helped by a $211M reserve release; reported EPS guidance raised to $18.30–$18.60 but the beat leans on a one-off GBTG gain.

triggers.label: U.S. consumer spend +9.4% YoY
triggers.quote: U.S. consumer spending was up 9.4% this quarter, reflecting the continued strength in our premium customer base.

triggers.label: Net card fees +17% FX-adjusted
triggers.quote: net card fee growth accelerating to 17%, FX adjusted

triggers.label: Reported EPS guide raised to $18.30–$18.60
triggers.quote: raising EPS guidance to a range of $18.30-$18.60 and $17.60-$17.90 on an adjusted basis

triggers.label: Middle-market share loss to Ramp, Brex
triggers.quote: we have not grown the way we want to grow, and that is why we did the Center acquisition

triggers.label: OCC consent order, legal reserves up
triggers.quote: the deficiencies cited in the consent order should not have occurred, and we are accountable for addressing them thoroughly

guidance.quote: reaffirming our full-year revenue growth guidance of 10%
raising EPS guidance to a range of $18.30-$18.60
raising EPS guidance to a range of $18.30-$18.60 and $17.60-$17.90 on an adjusted basis

red_flags.label: OCC civil money penalty / consent order
red_flags.quote: The deficiencies cited in the consent order should not have occurred, and we are accountable for addressing them thoroughly

red_flags.label: Reported EPS lifted by one-off GBTG gain
red_flags.quote: a $1.11 per share gain from the sale of Global Business Travel Group

red_flags.label: Reserve release flatters provision
red_flags.quote: Overall provision expense was $985 million, including a reserve release of $211 million.

evasions.quote: We are not going to get into guidance for 2027 at this stage, Ryan.
I think it's a little too early in the game to determine what the impact will be on VCE.
